description: Israeli media reports suggest Iran's Supreme Leader issued an ultimatum to President Pezeshkian regarding resignation.  The report claims the IRGC commander now holds greater influence over strategic decisions.  US President Trump stated Iran has a "last chance" to reach an agreement.  Diplomatic efforts are continuing through mediators despite public denials of talks.  Regional allies urged the US to pursue diplomacy after a planned military strike pause.
title: Will next resignation of Iran Prez be accepted? Report claims 'ultimatum' by Khamenei

author: YAZHINIYAN
description: TVK has filed a complaint with the National Commission for Women. The complaint targets Udhayanidhi Stalin for alleged vulgar and sexually suggestive remarks. These remarks were reportedly made during a rally in Thanjavur concerning the Cauvery issue. TVK seeks an apology and legal proceedings against the opposition leader. The party stated such comments normalize objectification and undermine women's dignity.
title: TVK files complaint against Udhayanidhi Stalin over 'vulgar' remarks

author: RAMENDRA SINGH
description: Children in Vidisha district risk daily commutes across a river. They use concrete pillars to shorten their journey to school. This dangerous route avoids a much longer road trip to the nearest secondary facility. Parents face difficult choices between safety and education for their children. Authorities have been informed and are seeking a swift resolution.
title: In MP village, kids risk lives every day, hop over dam pillars to reach school

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: China's open-weight AI models are rapidly advancing, potentially surpassing American developers soon. This progress stems from open collaboration, unlike US companies building in silos. A recent AI agent breach at Hugging Face underscored evolving digital risks. Hugging Face used a Chinese open-weight model to resolve the security incident. AI cybersecurity is predicted to become a massive global market driven by open-source models.
title: OpenAI models hacked Hugging Face; CEO warns America on Chinese AI

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: After the recent success of Dilip Gavit and Mohammed Basil, Indian para athletes and coaches have come forward with formal complaints against a member of the IOA media committee. The allegations detail instances of rude behaviour directed at the para athletes, leading to a heated confrontation that spiraled into a brief physical clash. The athletes are calling for the IOA to take action regarding the official's conduct during the Games.
title: CWG para champions complain against IOA staff, seek action over 'misconduct'

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: WhatsApp puts multiple accounts under review, temporarily blocks access for users

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
title: Indian agents killed over 30 LeT operatives in Pak since 2020, claims Lashkar leader

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Connor McDavid’s wife, Lauren Kyle, has shared a rare glimpse of the Edmonton Oilers' captain just weeks before the training camp is set to begin.
title: Lauren Kyle shares heartfelt update on Connor McDavid before training camp

author: AHSAN TASNIM
description: Bangladesh seeks India's clarification on supporting Sheikh Hasina's upcoming virtual address.  Dhaka wants assurances that Indian territory will not be used for political statements.  The government fears such activities could destabilize Bangladesh and harm bilateral ties.  India has previously indicated it does not expect fugitives to make political statements.  No decision has been made regarding Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's attendance at the BRICS Summit.
title: Bangladesh seeks India’s stand on Sheikh Hasina’s Aug 5 virtual address

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: UFC flyweight Allan Nascimento has died at the age of 34, just weeks after his most recent fight. The promotion confirmed he suffered a medical emergency and shared details in an official statement. A Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt, Nascimento compiled a 22-7 professional record and earned respect for his submission skills. Tributes have poured in from fellow UFC stars, including Dustin Poirier, Henry Cejudo and Mackenzie Dern.
title: UFC fighter Allan Nascimento dies aged 34 after apparent heart attack

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Yash Vir Singh arrived in Glasgow with little attention but left with a Commonwealth Games bronze after a personal-best final throw. In this interview with TimesofIndia.com, he opens up about the injury that nearly derailed his career, the months spent in rehabilitation, Neeraj Chopra's words before his medal-winning attempt and the father who has guided him since his first throws with a bamboo javelin.
title: Shoulder surgery, 7 months out, one throw: How Yash Vir Singh won CWG bronze

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: T Dilip concluded his five-year tenure as India's fielding coach with a heartfelt farewell message. He significantly transformed the team's fielding culture during his impactful service. The innovative fielding medal ceremony became a memorable dressing-room tradition during his tenure. Dilip cherished being part of numerous team triumphs across various formats.
title: 'Forever grateful': Dilip bids emotional farewell after 5 years with Team India

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices saw a modest recovery on Tuesday after a significant decline. Benchmark Brent crude climbed to $84.26 and WTI crude reached $80.75. This rebound followed a sharp slide after US President Donald Trump paused military action against Iran. Shipping patterns are changing, and concerns about energy supply risks persist. Oil prices remain below their earlier peak of $126 per barrel.
title: Oil rebounds from three-week low as Hormuz tensions keep supply fears alive

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: A Noida teenager and her mother have moved homes three times after an FIR was filed. The FIR, based on a video, names the 15-year-old for alleged profanities. She has since apologized and is receiving threats on social media. Police personnel and strangers visited their residence, causing safety concerns for the family. The family has moved to an undisclosed location due to ongoing threats.
title: 'Being hounded despite apology’: Noida teen in PM abuse FIR forced to change homes

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 25 US states sue Trump over fresh tariffs on 60 trading partners, including India

author: SANJAY KHAJURIA
description: Twenty-one Bangladesh nationals were detained in Ramban district last week.  Officials are questioning them to learn who facilitated their movement.  The group was caught moving in two vehicles during a checking drive.  None of them could produce valid identity or travel documents.  Investigators are probing if any network assisted these illegal immigrants.
title: 21 Bangladesh nationals detained in J&K’s Ramban

author: TNN
description: A parliamentary panel suggests lowering the minimum director age to eighteen years.  The committee also backs raising the maximum director age to seventy-five years.  Special NCLT benches for insolvency matters are recommended for efficient asset resolution.  The panel proposes retaining the ten crore net profit threshold for CSR applicability.  New provisions will enable seamless re-domiciliation of foreign companies to IFSC.
title: Lower min age for MD, directors to 18: Parliamentary panel

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan continues to perform well at the box office, earning over Rs 3.85 crore on its twelfth day. The film has achieved a total India gross collection of Rs 209.35 crore and Rs 179.45 crore net. Overseas collections have also been strong, contributing Rs 1 crore on day twelve. This brings the worldwide gross collection for Jana Nayagan to Rs 301.35 crore. The political action drama saw a 28.
title: Vijay's Jana Nayagan crosses Rs 300 crore worldwide on Day 12

author: KOUSHIKI SAHA
description: A Delhi court has acquitted former WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh.  The sexual harassment case involved allegations from several women wrestlers.  Suspended WFI assistant secretary Vinod Tomar was also found not guilty.  The trial concluded after three years with the court examining many witnesses.  This verdict follows months of protests by prominent wrestlers demanding justice.
title: Brij Bhushan acquitted in sexual harassment case

author: TNN
description: The Supreme Court has asked the Centre and Delhi authorities for their responses.  A PIL seeks designated protest sites, citing Jantar Mantar's lack of amenities.  The court noted Jantar Mantar's unsuitability for holding protests and basic facilities.  Petitioner mentioned potential marches and police actions to prevent violence.  Authorities are responsible for handling emerging situations and ensuring law takes its course.
title: Jantar Mantar not okay for protests? SC seeks replies

author: MANUJA VEERAPPA
description: Hockey India president Dilip Tirkey questions the director general's authority.  He seeks accountability and transparency in the recent jersey colour change.  Tirkey expressed surprise at learning about the redesign through social media.  He emphasised the need for governance and consultation for symbolic decisions.  The president requested a comprehensive reply with documentary evidence by Tuesday.
title: ‘Who approved it?’: HI president Dilip Tirkey seeks answers on jersey switch

author: JAI NARAIN PANDEY
description: Prashant Kishor secured his first electoral victory in the Bankipur bypoll. This win challenges the established green and saffron political dominance in Bihar. Kishor, a renowned political strategist, launched his Jan Suraaj Party after extensive grassroots work. His victory sends a message to national parties regarding key issues. The outcome suggests Bihar may accommodate a third political force.
title: Bankipur bypoll: PK adds a dash of yellow to Bihar palette of saffron & green

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Colombian authorities have intercepted a fishing vessel carrying approximately 1,764 pounds of suspected illegally caught marine animals believed to have been taken from the protected Malpelo Fauna and Flora Sanctuary, bringing renewed attention to illegal fishing in one of the country's most ecologically important marine reserves.
title: Colombia intercepts boat carrying 1,764 pounds of marine animals

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: In a harrowing incident in Faridabad, a young teacher was brutally murdered by a stalker who deceived her into meeting him at the school gate by using her husband's name. The attacker stabbed her repeatedly, exceeding twenty times, in front of both students and staff. Authorities apprehended the 21-year-old assailant within hours. The victim, a mother of two, had previously warned the stalker about impending legal action.
title: Stalker uses husband's name to lure teacher, stabs her 20 times in Faridabad

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Fifty years ago, American red crayfish were introduced to Spain's Guadalquivir River basin, and they have since established a permanent presence. These aggressive invaders have wreaked havoc on local wildlife and disrupted aquatic ecosystems. Yet, local communities have successfully built an economy around their harvesting and processing. This dependence has sparked legal disputes, resulting in a compromise that permits regulated harvesting, balancing ecological health with economic viability.
title: Spain imported US crayfish in 1974; 50 years later, they cannot be removed

author: AVISHEK KUMAR
description: Pilgrims’ Protest Stalls Traffic, Cops Advance One-Way Traffic Plan
title: Ambulance with patient stranded for 50 minutes in Gzb after crash with kanwar trolley
